explanation: Recency Markov - This model applies an exponential decay to historical observations, prioritizing the most recent price action over old data. It operates with signal parameters such as state_len=4, lookback=500, decay_lambda=0.001, min_effective_samples=30, trade_threshold=0.6, prob_gap_min=0.18. To control risk, it halts trading after 2 consecutive daily losses, restricts to 8 max trades per day, and sets a daily stop loss at 1 units. It dynamically stops trading after excessive continuous market streaks to avoid severe drawdowns. It avoids trading during highly dominant one-sided market periods (anti-chop mechanism).
